title.narrative: Honey and Arabica Resilience for Value, Equity, Sustainability & Transformation

description.narrative: Mt. Elgon Coffee and Honey Cooperative Society Limited (MECHCSL) is a key smallholder organisation in Eastern Uganda, serving producers of Arabica coffee and apiary products across the Mt. Elgon highlands. The cooperative has steadily expanded its membership and production base, with Arabica coffee and honey increasingly becoming the region's most competitive commodities due to favourable altitude, rich biodiversity, and a growing demand for specialty coffee and organic honey. Despite this potential, farmers continue to grapple with climate variability, fluctuating market prices, limited processing capacity, and low value capture at farm level. To address these gaps, MECHCSL is implementing the HARVEST; Honey and Arabica Resilience for Value Equity, Sustainability and Transformation project in partnership with We Effect. The project seeks to enhance the cooperative's business performance by improving production quality, strengthening post-harvest management, and expanding market access for both coffee and honey. It aims to build climate resilience through training in climate-smart farming, promote value addition, and position producers to access premium and specialty markets. HARVEST also prioritises women and youth inclusion, improved governance, and diversified income opportunities. By creating an efficient, sustainable, and market-oriented cooperative model, the project intends to elevate household incomes, strengthen environmental stewardship, and drive long-term socio-economic transformation in the Mt. Elgon region.
